note: Triennial election of the rural district council, polled on Thursday 2 June 1927. The Larne Times nomination-day report lists all 16 district electoral divisions: contests in Ardclinis and Cairncastle; Islandmagee South left with one nominee after the retiring member withdrew; 11 other divisions with a single nominee; no nominations for Ballycorr and Templecorran, whose retiring members were deemed re-elected. The first meeting of the new council (LT 11 June 1927) names sixteen elected members. Sole nominee (retiring member). Printed 'Edward Co[...] Smith' at the faded page edge; initial C. as in other rounds. Returned unopposed.
